title: Dutch slave trade
descriptions: This dataset contains information on the seavoyage of Dutch slave traders in the 17th and 18th century. It includes the number of slaves that boarded the ship in Africa, the number of deaths, places of departure and places of landing, etc. A codebook explaining the collumns of the datasheet is attached.
